holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: For the quarter ended September 2026, net profit reached Rs 21,537 crore on revenue of Rs 95,132 crore.
Kaizad Bharucha will cease to be Deputy Managing Director on December 31, 2026, while Lily Vadera was reappointed as an independent director for three years.
The bank initiated an internal probe regarding alleged leaks of confidential information involving two senior executives.
HDFC Bank shares traded near 52-week lows ahead of an upcoming CEO handover.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank is the fund's largest single holding at a 7.06% allocation. Its 6.73% decline over the past 3 months generated an estimated -0.475% drag on fund performance, making it one of the largest negative contributors.

watch.text: Track the outcome and governance findings of the internal investigation into executive information leaks.
Monitor the leadership transition following the CEO handover and the Deputy MD departure scheduled for December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: For the quarter ended September 2026, net profit stood at Rs 7,666 crore on revenue of Rs 38,087 crore.
Rahul Shukla was appointed Group Head of Commercial and Bharat Banking effective October 19, 2026.
The stock dropped over 4% post-Q2 results as quarterly net profit fell short of expectations despite a 38% year-on-year increase.

expected.text: Axis Bank's FY27 loan growth estimate was revised to 20%, with the FY28 forecast maintained at 15%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank is the fund's second-largest holding at 5.07% weight. A sharp post-earnings decline creates a significant performance headwind within the fund's 28.4% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Watch whether loan growth achieves the 20% estimate for FY27.
Observe business expansion under the newly appointed head of Commercial and Bharat Banking.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Infosys posted Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 7,823 crore, declared an interim dividend of Rs 26 per share, and granted 9,640 RSUs.
The company reduced its annual revenue growth guidance, causing its American Depositary Receipts to fall 6%.
Infosys and Truist expanded their collaboration to build a Global Capability Center in Hyderabad, onboarding over 1,000 personnel.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys constitutes 3.06% of the fund and generated a 10.85% return over 3 months, adding +0.332% to fund returns as the second-largest positive contributor.

watch.text: Monitor full-year revenue progression against the lowered annual growth guidance.
Track delivery milestones and headcount scaling from the expanded Truist Global Capability Center.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank reported standalone net profit of Rs 14,843 crore and consolidated net profit of Rs 16,333 crore for Q2 FY27.
CASA ratio declined by 340 bps to 36.1% alongside an increase in FCNR (B) deposits.
The bank revised select savings account cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026, and raised fixed deposit rates.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.97% fund weight, ICICI Bank provides key exposure within the 28.4% financial sector basket, exhibiting modest 3-month return compression of -2.70%.

watch.text: Track the impact of deposit rate revisions and savings charge adjustments taking effect December 1, 2026.
Monitor CASA ratio trends following the drop to 36.1%.

holdings.name: Linde India Ltd

what_changed.text: Linde India acquired two 1,800 TPD air separation units at Tata Steel Kalinganagar and started gas supply.
The company clarified to the stock exchange that no undisclosed corporate events caused the recent spurt in trading volume.
June 2026 quarter net profit was Rs 105 crore on sales of Rs 694 crore, compared to Rs 171 crore profit in September 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.79% weight, Linde India fell 14.95% over the 3-month period, reducing fund performance by an estimated -0.268%.

watch.text: Follow commercial off-take volumes and revenue contribution from the newly acquired Kalinganagar air separation units.

holdings.name: NTPC Ltd

what_changed.text: Diwakar Nath Misra, Additional Secretary at the Ministry of Power, was appointed Government Nominee Director on NTPC's board.
NTPC denied published reports concerning a 7.43% profit growth and a share buyback schedule.
The company decided to initiate feasibility studies across additional states for its nuclear power programme.
NTPC shares hit a 52-week low on October 22, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: NTPC accounts for 1.79% of the fund and anchors its 7.1% Energy & Utilities allocation. The stock fell 14.17% over the past 3 months.

watch.text: Track the board meeting on October 31, 2026, for Q2 FY27 results and consideration of a first interim dividend.
Monitor regulatory developments regarding feasibility studies for state nuclear expansion.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T bagged large orders to build Secretariat buildings in New Delhi and office towers in Amaravati.
The company received a limited notice to proceed for the New Tashkent airport project and commenced pre-construction activities.
The Indian Navy commissioned Samarthak, a major warship built by L&T.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 1.74% of the fund, providing critical weight to the 13.3% Industrials allocation. It declined 3.66% over 3 months.

watch.text: Review Q2 and half-year FY27 financial results and order inflow announcements scheduled for October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd

what_changed.text: The Ontario authority approved the dissolution of inactive indirect subsidiary Yachiyo Canada.
The New York State Workers' Compensation Board issued a penalty of USD 19,500 to subsidiary Motherson Technology Services USA.
The company disbursed interest and settled fractional entitlements resulting from CCD conversions.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.70% fund weight, the stock advanced 4.20% over 3 months and 41.34% over 1 year, outperforming the broader fund return during a period of market weakness.

watch.text: Monitor the board meeting scheduled for November 5, 2026, to review Q2 and H1 FY27 standalone and consolidated results.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: For the quarter ended September 2026, net profit grew to Rs 6,367 crore, with Gross NPA at 1.06% and Net NPA at 0.42%.
Bajaj Finance issued 2,12,000 secured NCDs aggregating to Rs 2,120 crore maturing in October 2031.
The stock dropped 3% after earnings as markets evaluated potential net interest margin contraction from rising funding costs.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bajaj Finance carries a 1.63% portfolio weight. Its 3-month return of -8.28% added to performance drag across the fund's financial holdings.

watch.text: Track net interest margins and funding costs following recent borrowing issuances.

holdings.name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 18.4% to Rs 19,206 crore and net profit rose 7.6% to Rs 743 crore, with 15 new stores opened.
Shares hit a 52-week low following earnings due to market concern over revenue growth outpacing profit growth.

holdings.why_it_matters: Avenue Supermarts represents 1.63% of the portfolio. Its 21.43% drop over 3 months caused an estimated -0.349% contribution loss, ranking among the fund's top detractors.

watch.text: Monitor margin expansion trends and store maturation dynamics after adding 15 stores in Q2 FY27.

portfolio.statement: Nippon India Multi Cap Fund holds 99.3% in equity across diversified market caps, heavily anchored by Financials (28.4%), Consumer Discretionary (19.7%), and Industrials (13.3%). Over the 3-month period, fund returns slipped -5.67%, driven down by sharp corrections in large financial and retail holdings despite positive performance in select IT and manufacturing names.
interp: Heavy exposure to large-cap lenders and retailers (HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Avenue Supermarts) proved to be the primary detractor over the last quarter.
Pockets of resilience in IT services (Infosys) and industrial auto components (Samvardhana Motherson) partially offset steeper drawdowns in capital goods and utilities.
portfolio.line: Performance was hampered by banking margin concerns, executive probes, and retail margin compression, despite steady contract wins in industrials.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank dropped near 52-week lows amid an internal investigation into senior-level confidential data leaks and executive exits.
Axis Bank shares fell over 4% after Q2 FY27 profits missed street expectations.
Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth projection, triggering an ADR decline of 6% despite declaring a Rs 26 dividend.
Avenue Supermarts fell to a 52-week low as Q2 net profit grew only 7.6% against 18.4% revenue expansion.
Bajaj Finance faced post-earnings share declines tied to anticipated margin pressure from elevated borrowing costs.

themes.title: Private Lending and Credit Re-pricing
themes.text: Major financial holdings are dealing with deposit mix shifts, higher funding costs, and management transitions.

themes.title: Domestic Infrastructure & Civil Contracts
themes.text: Order books remain active with large administrative, airport, and utility feasibility initiatives.

themes.title: Consumer Retail Margin Compression
themes.text: Store additions continue, but bottom-line growth is lagging topline growth in brick-and-mortar retail.

macro.factor: Banking Cost of Funds and Deposit Pressure
macro.why: Rising domestic deposit costs and lower CASA ratios compress net interest margins for large lenders and NBFCs.
Moderating IT client budgets directly impact full-year guidance and offshore revenue growth trajectories.
Execution velocity on state capital expenditure and heavy industrial gas contracts dictates quarterly revenues.

priced_in.text: Profitability shortfall relative to expectations in Axis Bank's September 2026 quarter results.
Slower annual revenue expansion for Infosys following its lowered guidance update.
Margin compression between revenue growth and net profit growth at Avenue Supermarts.

could_change.title: Resolution of HDFC Bank Executive Leak Probe
could_change.text: Findings from the internal data probe and stabilization under incoming leadership could restore market confidence in the portfolio's top holding.

could_change.title: Rebound in Retail Operating Leverage
could_change.text: If Avenue Supermarts' newly added 15 stores reach profitability faster, operating margins could realign with revenue growth.

portfolio.risk_note: With 28.4% of the fund in Financials and the top two holdings (HDFC Bank and Axis Bank) making up over 12% of total assets, performance remains highly exposed to domestic banking net interest margin trends and regulatory or governance challenges.
